title: Nice Set of Heavy Duty Glass Containers with covers; better than plastic for food storage
text: Nice Set of Heavy Duty Glass Containers with covers; better than plastic for food storage. Nothing beats glass for food storage.  Plastic containers always seem to warp or take on odors or colors of the food.  Also heating in plastic is less than ideal.  This is a nice variety of different sized glass containers.  The plastic covers seem to fit tightly.  Note that there are 4 pieces that I guess you would call dessert cups with a decorative border along the top and these do NOT come with covers.  I thought maybe the similar size dish covers would work, but they don't fit.  You only really want to use those 4 for something that you would finish eating at one time.  If you have food left in them, you would have to transfer it to a container with a cover or cover with plastic wrap.  The set is heavy thick glass and seem less likely to break if you drop them than thinner, cheaper glass containers.  I didn't drop one to find out if it would break.  Pyrex is a trusted name in glassware and I have some older Pyrex that has been in use for years.  One reviewer says that new Pyrex does not use the same glass formula and that these are more prone to breakage especially when subjecting them to temperature variations.  Some common sense here probably would easily prevent any problem.  Even if the glass can withstand it, generally it is not a good idea to take a container of food that has been heated and stick it in the refrigerator right away.  Let it cool to room temperature first and then refrigerate.  Also if you take something out of the refrigerator, don't heat it up right away; again give it some time to reach room temperature.  Those precautions are smart to use with any containers, but especially glass and should prevent any potential shattering problems.  The full set is quite heavy and difficult to lift, which is the main downside if you want to transfer the whole set from one place to another.  Of course once you take it from the box, you probably wouldn't be moving the whole set at once.  Just be aware that if you want to use this as a gift, it is heavy and difficult to move.  If you are a strong, young person you probably can manage it okay, but you wouldn't want to carry it very far.  One other thing I didn't like was the color of the covers.  In addition to red, it would have been nice to have a couple other colors such as green, blue or yellow, just for some variety and potentially color coding your food items.  Not a big deal, but the red seemed a little garish.  The marked down price that Amazon is currently offering seems very reasonable for a set like this.  A few single pieces of quality glassware could cost you as much as this whole set.  Remember those that in addition to the 4 dessert cups, you really only get 12 other pieces of glassware, as the 12 covers count as part of the total 28 pieces.

description: This 28-piece set includes all the durable, versatile pieces you need for mixing, baking, serving and storing. The two Baking Dishes are perfect for main dishes, and include Easy Grab handles, which makes transporting simple. The medium-size mixing bowl is a great fit for most recipes. The nine glass storage containers, in 4 sizes, have secure-fit lids to keep food fresh. And the durable custard cups are a must-have for snacks and desserts. This set includes (1) 2-QT Easy Grab Baking Dish with Lid, (1) 3-QT Easy Grab Baking Dish with Lid, (1) 1.5-QT Glass Mixing Bowl with Lid, (1) 7-cup Glass Storage Container with Lid, (2) 4-cup Glass Storage Containers with Lids, (3) 2-cup Glass Storage Containers with Lids, (3) 1-cup Glass Storage Containers with Lids and (4) 6-oz Glass Custard Cups
